options.content:
## Trace drilldown

The panels above query Tempo directly. Use Explore -> Tempo for deeper waterfall inspection when a panel turns red or spikes.

**All Snowcast traces**

`{ resource.service.name = "snowcast" }`

**Slow search traces**

`{ resource.service.name = "snowcast" && span:name = "api.search" && span:duration > 5s }`

**Search phase spans**

`{ resource.service.name = "snowcast" && span:name =~ "search\..*" }`

**LLM parser spans**

`{ resource.service.name = "snowcast" && span:name = "llm.query_parser" }`

Production should keep `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=1.0` while real traffic is low; reduce sampling later only when trace volume becomes meaningful.

spec.description: Successful and failed conditions refresh events by source/reason. No data means scheduled jobs are not exporting telemetry yet.

spec.description: Fallback rate by reason. This catches LLM outages or schema failures even when search still works.

spec.description: Compares full /api/search HTTP route latency with the internal domain search timer. HTTP includes FastAPI request handling, response model construction/JSON serialization, and middleware overhead. Use Tempo traces when this gap is sustained.
